t.zh: 拼写纠错：输错一个词时，看它离正确的词有多远。这一关只许一种改法：把一个字母换成另一个，每换一个算 1 步。两个词一样长。
t.en: Spelling correction: when a word is mistyped, see how far it is from the right one. In this level only one kind of change is allowed: swap one letter for another, 1 step each. The two words are the same length.

t.zh: 表还是对齐表：上面一个词，左边一个词。只换字母时，左边第 i 个字母只会对上上面第 i 个，所以答案沿着对角线走过来。
t.en: The table is still the alignment table: one word along the top, one down the left. With swaps only, letter i on the left only ever lines up with letter i on top, so the answer comes down the diagonal.

goal.zh: 算出把左边的词改成上面的词，最少要换几个字母。
goal.en: Work out the fewest letters to swap to turn the word on the left into the word on top.

how.zh: 左上那一格是「前面的字母都改好了」。
how.en: The cell up-left means “all the letters before are already fixed”.

say.zh: 这一关只许换字母，用不上上面和左边：只看左上。
say.en: This level only allows swaps, so up and left are no use: look only at up-left.

hints.zh: 字母相同就不用换：左上原样留下。不同就换一个：左上 + 1。取较小。
hints.en: If the letters match, nothing to swap: keep up-left as it is. If they differ, swap one: up-left + 1. Take the smaller.

hints.zh: 起点是两个空词，0 步。
hints.en: The start is two empty words: 0 steps.

body.zh: 只看左上：前面都改好了，这一个字母要么不动，要么换掉。
body.en: Up-left only: everything before is fixed, and this letter either stays or is swapped.
